# Geocode

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Geocode`](gmeow-Geocode.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Geocode>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A geographic location code expressed in an alternative geocoding reference frame — a Plus Code, what3words address, geohash, MGRS grid reference, UN/LOCODE, or linear-referencing mile-marker.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Geocode`](gmeow-Geocode.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for an alternative geocoding identifier — Plus Code, what3words, geohash, MGRS, UN/LOCODE, mile-marker — carried in its own reference frame.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for decimal lat/long ([`GeoCoordinates`](gmeow-GeoCoordinates.md)) and avoid asserting conversion to WGS84 as triples — that is a solver computation ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

### How to use

- Mint a [`Geocode`](gmeow-Geocode.md), set the functional [`gmeow:geocodeFrame`](../properties/gmeow-geocodeFrame.md) and one [`gmeow:geocodeValue`](../properties/gmeow-geocodeValue.md) (or a per-system accessor like [`gmeow:plusCode`](../properties/gmeow-plusCode.md)), and link from the place via [`gmeow:hasGeocode`](../properties/gmeow-hasGeocode.md).

### Examples

- ex:loc a [`gmeow:Geocode`](gmeow-Geocode.md); [`gmeow:plusCode`](../properties/gmeow-plusCode.md) "9F4W9C8C+W4"; [`gmeow:geocodeFrame`](../properties/gmeow-geocodeFrame.md) [`gmeow:referenceFramePlusCode`](../individuals/gmeow-referenceFramePlusCode.md).
